eras.name: Post-war front-engine
eras.blurb: Supercharged 1.5 L and 4.5 L front-engined cars on skinny treaded tyres.

eras.name: 2.5 L front-engine
eras.blurb: The Fangio/Moss years; rear-engined Coopers took over by the end of it.

eras.name: 1.5 L rear-engine
eras.blurb: Light, low-power, slippery cars where momentum was everything.

eras.name: 3.0 L, wings arrive
eras.blurb: The 'return to power', then wings (1968) and slick tyres (1971).

eras.name: Ground-effect wing cars
eras.blurb: Venturi tunnels and sliding skirts: huge cornering speeds and rock-hard suspension.

eras.name: Turbo flat-bottom
eras.blurb: 1000+ hp qualifying turbos, boost and fuel-consumption management.

eras.name: Naturally aspirated + electronics
eras.blurb: 3.5 L V8/V10/V12, semi-automatic gearboxes, active suspension peaking in 1992-93.

eras.name: 3.0 L V10 slicks
eras.blurb: Smaller engines, refuelling strategy racing, last of the slick tyres.

eras.name: Grooved-tyre V10
eras.blurb: Narrow cars, grooved tyres, a tyre war and (from 2001) traction control.

eras.name: 2.4 L V8 refuelling
eras.blurb: V8s, aero-heavy cars; traction control banned for 2008.

eras.name: V8, KERS and Pirelli
eras.blurb: Aero overhaul, no refuelling from 2010, exhaust-blown diffusers, high-deg Pirellis.

eras.name: Hybrid V6 turbo (narrow)
eras.blurb: 1.6 L turbo hybrids with energy recovery; low downforce, lots of torque.

eras.name: Hybrid wide high-downforce
eras.blurb: Wider cars and tyres, the fastest F1 cars ever over a lap; dirty air hurt following.

eras.name: Ground-effect hybrid
eras.blurb: Venturi floors return; stiff, heavy cars that punish porpoising and bumps.

eras.name: Active aero, 50/50 hybrid
eras.blurb: Smaller, lighter cars with movable wings and roughly half the power from the battery.
